items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: On the roof garden with, uh, Big Eye Louie and Caffrey.

ctx.x: Were there any other favorite pianists that were unusually good that you liked?

Well, at that time, mm-hmm. There was a lady piano player playin' on the roof garden. And, uh, at that time when I was a boy, when I used to go up there when I was a young man, a young boy, I used to go up there and dance. Before I started to playin', I used to go up there when, uh, Manuel, uh, Peris was playin' up on the roof. Mm-hmm. On the roof garden with, uh, Big Eye Louie and Caffrey. And that lady, what's her name again, uh, let's see if I can call her name.
But I knew they had a clan that play a playin' up there.
